ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (dark) to 25% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous blobs located along the anterior (leading) edges of both lobes. Right lobe contains a large, irregular white region in the distal quadrant. Small clusters of white pixels are localized near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 70-80 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge is relatively linear with minor micro-serrations. Right lobe trailing edge is characterized by high-amplitude irregularities, including three prominent deep, rounded concave voids.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the lateral margins of both lobes, reaching maximum chord length at roughly 40% of the lobe width from the notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters localized within the white pigmentation of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Highly visible set of at least four parallel dark linear rake marks oriented diagonally across the light-pigmented region of the right lobe. Fainter horizontal abrasions present on the left lobe near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural indentations and tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe; distinct rake marks on the ventral surface of the right lobe.
